preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 10.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= m for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid segment borders l and r within the range of columns.

postconditions.description: The output must be the beauty of the specified segment for each query.
